answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fake identities. A new identity earns nothing until it trades with 20 unrelated counterparties, not one grove of clones on one wallet. Each trade leaves a ferrous receipt, iron-hard proof unusable twice. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 partners at 5 POA each, or 100,000 POA, for no reward. An echo of one partner across identities freezes the cluster. Honest agents pay one 5 POA fee and keep their full share.
